Requirements: R ≥ 4.1. Before first use, install dependencies by running:
This installs the required CRAN packages (shiny, DT, jsonlite, base64enc, uuid, sp) and Bioconductor packages (SingleCellExperiment, SummarizedExperiment, S4Vectors, flowCore, xml2) if they are not already present.
```{r}
source("path/to/GateLabR/install_dependencies.R")
```


To launch the app, load your SCE object and then source launch.R from the GateLabR folder:
The app will open in your browser. From there you can import FCS files, draw gates, import/export GatingML, and export gated populations as FCS files.
```{r}
# Load your data first
sce <- readRDS("path/to/your_data.rds")   # or however you load it

# Then launch
source("path/to/GateLabR/launch.R")
launchGatingApp(sce)

```
